rootDecision: Accept these three prospective title mappings under unchanged Product retirement meaning; no case deletion or result credit

mappings.priorTitle: complete-pair owners refuse orphan F_H, construction-intent and selected-action operations by stage and admission order, alike warm, copied and cold; a mixed arm is refused at admission; the baseline and unrelated growth keep their values
mappings.successorTitle: complete-pair owners refuse retired construction-intent and selected-action continuations and orphan F_H operations as one F_H orphan set, alike warm, copied and cold; a mixed arm is refused at admission; the baseline and unrelated growth keep their values
mappings.basis: Fixed15-family5.0 retirement: one F_H orphan set; selected_action absent from publication; pending current_intent refusal laws retained

mappings.priorTitle: selected_action keeps its published definition and the installed transport refuses it installed_binding_unavailable
mappings.successorTitle: selected_action is retired from the published continue family and the installed transport refuses a selected_action call unknown_definition
mappings.basis: Fixed15-family5.0 retirement: one F_H orphan set; selected_action absent from publication; pending current_intent refusal laws retained

mappings.priorTitle: the published continue refusal contracts keep the selected_action list and give current_intent the five pending codes
mappings.successorTitle: the published continue refusal contracts give current_intent the five pending codes and publish no selected_action list
mappings.basis: Fixed15-family5.0 retirement: one F_H orphan set; selected_action absent from publication; pending current_intent refusal laws retained
